about.text: A sampler plugin I built in C++/JUCE to solve problems I had making music. Granular synthesis, hand-coded tremolo DSP, zero-delay TPT filters, compressor, and tempo control via resampling. Everything is DAW-automatable through APVTS with lock-free parameter access on the audio thread.
